Definition: middle voice from G1142; to be exercised by a dæmon:--have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).
BiblicalUsage: To be demon-possessed is to be held by a demon, and the Gospels show the condition in all its misery: the man among the tombs, fierce and uncontrollable; the boy thrown down and tormented; the daughter grievously vexed. In every case the person is brought to Jesus, and in every case He frees them. Even the charge against Jesus Himself was that He had a devil, which His works answered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these accounts are given so that sufferers and their families know where to turn. Christ's authority over demons is not a theory; it is the freedom of real people, and it still stands.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac; The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
